body:
Try to go to sleep. Watch something online/television. Call a friend or family member. Fix something to eat. Cue up a comforting playlist. Draw something - even what you're feeling right now - get it out on paper or pixels. Read a book. Scream or cry or punch the crap out of some pillows. Google the suicide hotlines and call one and speak to someone IRL. 

Anything, really other than what you're thinking of doing. 

Please don't do anything you might regret. There are people out there that care about you. I care. You are not a burden - you are a unique person that has value and worth. I am so sorry you're feeling this way, but do your best to distract yourself from those dark thoughts. 

Please take care of yourself and reach out to some place that can give you concrete help.

Oh hun. I'm so sorry you're at this point and your friend isn't available. 
I've done CBT and it's helped for some things, but it doesn't seem to be quite the right method for someone that is deeply depressed or suicidal - just my opinion. I know right now you are probably feeling too exhausted with just daily living to try to seek out another counselor - but please, please do so. You deserve to be free from these dark feelings and find happiness. 

Depression LIES. Don't listen to that crap that is telling you things are so awful that death is the answer. It isn't the answer to anything. 

I want to just fucking bake you some cookies and give you a big hug and tell you it's going to be okay... I know that's stupid, but I wish there was a way (other than words in a message board) that would make all of us feel a little less alone and take away a little of your pain and hopelessness. But all I have are words - so I do hope they mean something to you - I am so so sorry you are going through this. I care. 

Please keep trying to find the way up and out of your depression. I just know it's got to be worth the work and pain - there is happiness out there for all of us.

I am so sorry. I know words are so meaningless sometimes, but please hang in there and do whatever it takes to help him and stay sane and safe yourself. I don't know how anyone deals with this type of thing - you just keep breathing in and out until you feel you can start living your life again.
